source: Official 127 SI brand kit (2023). Files copied from 127si-challenge-platform public/brand on 2026-11-11 and renamed; the artwork is unchanged.
rules: Never redraw, recolour, stretch, crop, rotate, outline, shadow or CSS-invert a logo or stamp. Use the white logo on blue, black or photo backgrounds.

logos.use: Blue and orange full lockup. Headers and covers on white or light backgrounds.
White lockup. Footers and anything on blue, black or a dark photo.
Circular mark. Compact navigation, avatars, app icons.
Black lockup, version 1. One-colour printing and forms.
Black lockup, version 2. One-colour printing and forms.

stampUse: Awards, certificates, apparel, athletic graphics, watermarks. Not in navigation or behind data.

patterns.use: Footer background at about 8% opacity (public shell standard).
Court-line texture. Not part of the 2023 kit; added in Challenge.

patternUse: Texture only, in empty or header areas. Never behind text that must be read or behind data.
notInThisPackage: Challenge's XP, streak and milestone badges and its product icons stay in 127si-challenge-platform public/brand. Favicons stay with each app.
